state: A synthetic insurance data audit found sum_insured values about 1000 times the median of other periods of the same policy. No source-system correction notice or currency-unit confirmation exists. Capital corrections have not been authorized. Decide how this anomaly should be handled.

capital_action.instructions: Given the audit evidence in state, choose the supported next action.

criteria.divide_now: Automatically divide all flagged sums insured by 1000 and accept them as correct.
criteria.review: Preserve amounts and route flagged records for actuarial and source-data review.
criteria.ignore: Declare the records correct and close the issue.
